facts.fact: Lei n.º 35/X/2023 (state budget 2024) sets the vote of the Ministério da Economia Digital at CVE 1,390,965,632, 1.62% of state expenditure of CVE 85,948,752,206.
facts.system: Ministério da Economia Digital vote, budget year 2024

facts.fact: Mapa VII of the 2024 budget law gives the programme Cabo Verde Plataforma Digital e da Inovação CVE 550,184,541 from the Treasury and CVE 18,000,000 from other national sources (CVE 568,184,541 of the state's own money) within a total of CVE 1,828,303,885, the rest being a CVE 1,239,119,344 external loan and a CVE 21,000,000 grant.
facts.system: Cabo Verde Plataforma Digital e da Inovação, budget year 2024

note: Part-loan-funded programme line counts as allocated because CVE 568m is domestic; CNPD and Modernização do Estado lines not taken as digital programmes; document says the FY2024 law carries no universal-service table.
